Imagine Black Friday... forever. Ninety percent off. Every day. It never ends.
A TV for nine dollars? I'll take ten!
Week two. You can't see the floor anymore. Just boxes.
Week three. Mom fights a grandma for the last toaster. The grandma wins.
Christmas. You open your present. It's a TV. You already have eleven.
Month six. The stores sold everything for almost nothing. One by one, they close.
Then Dad finds the last store on Earth. One toaster. Full price: thirty dollars.
